name: motion-devops
description: Frame-seekable HyperFrames motion explainers for DevOps topics

scripts.build:all: for d in src/*/story.mjs; do s=$(basename $(dirname $d)); node scripts/build-video.mjs $s > /dev/null || exit 1; echo built $s; done
scripts.test: node scripts/verify-all.mjs && node scripts/test-verifiers.mjs && node scripts/verify-starter.mjs
